title: StrategyXirrReport
description: Standardized Tier 4 Consolidated Strategy True XIRR & Friction Audit Report across multi-account domestic and foreign brokerage ledgers.

strategy_id.description: Identifier of the Investment Way matching config/investment_ways.yaml (e.g. fundamental_lts).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this XIRR performance report was generated.

base_currency.description: Strategy base currency code (e.g. INR, USD) in which all cashflows and returns are evaluated.

eval_date.description: Valuation cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD) for terminal equity injection.

xirr.description: Annualized internal rate of return as a decimal (e.g. 0.185 for 18.5%), or null if sub-annual guardrail triggered or unsolvable.

xirr_annualized.description: Annualized internal rate of return expressed as a percentage (e.g. 18.5 for 18.5%), or null if sub-annual guardrail triggered.

absolute_return.description: Total absolute percentage return on net invested capital.

total_deposited.description: Total external cash deposited across all assigned accounts in strategy base currency.

total_withdrawn.description: Total external cash withdrawn/paid out to bank accounts in strategy base currency.

net_invested.description: Net capital committed (total_deposited - total_withdrawn) in strategy base currency.

terminal_equity.description: Terminal strategy portfolio equity (blended equity market value + pooled cash) on eval_date in base currency.

days_held.description: Elapsed calendar days between first external cash deposit and eval_date.

is_sub_annual.description: True if duration is under 90 days, activating guardrail suppression of annualized XIRR.

brokerage.description: Total brokerage commissions paid across all assigned accounts in base currency.

stt.description: Securities Transaction Tax (STT) and exchange transaction levies in base currency.

fx_drag.description: Cross-border currency conversion fees and spread drag in base currency.

taxes_and_charges.description: GST, SEBI turnover fees, and stamp duty charges in base currency.

total_friction.description: Sum of all friction costs in strategy base currency.

friction_drag_pct.description: Impact of friction costs in percentage points (Gross Return % - Net Return %).

account_cashflows_summary.description: Summary of external inflows, withdrawals, netted transfers, and friction per assigned account.

broker.description: Broker name (e.g. Angel One, INDmoney / DriveWealth).

fx_rate.description: Exchange rate applied to convert native account currency to strategy base currency.

total_deposited_base.description: Total external cash deposited into this account in base currency.

total_withdrawn_base.description: Total external cash withdrawn from this account in base currency.

internal_transfers_netted_base.description: Amount of inter-account transfers netted out for this account in base currency.

friction_base.description: Total friction fees generated by this account in base currency.

cashflows.description: Full chronological ledger of cashflows submitted to the Newton-Raphson XIRR solver.

date.description: Cashflow transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

amount.description: Cashflow amount in strategy base currency (negative for external deposits, positive for withdrawals and terminal equity).

account_id.description: Originating broker account ID, or strategy identifier for terminal equity.

original_amount.description: Unconverted transaction amount in original currency.

fx_rate.description: FX multiplier used to convert to strategy base currency.
